Keep identical big round head, tiny squat body, thick dark outline, simple flat cel shading, blue-purple broad hair locks, pink-inner blue cat ears, top curl, star clip on VIEWER-RIGHT, VIEWER-LEFT magenta iris and VIEWER-RIGHT amber iris, white/navy-purple dress with gold chest star, boots and ONE attached blue-purple tail on VIEWER-RIGHT. No side swaps, no extra anatomy, no accessory redesign. True transparent alpha, no background, ground shadow, grids, text, numbers, effects or new props. Full body and all hair/ears/tail fit inside every cell with generous clear margins. Never scale the head between frames.
Input2 is the approved awake-seated endpoint. Create ONE coherent TWELVE-frame sprite sheet, FOUR columns by THREE rows,2048x1536. Every cell512x512 with fixed centerx256 and foot/contact liney465. Input1 standing scale and Input2 seated head size are identical; preserve this exact head width and hair volume through all frames. This replaces flickering drawings from multiple generations, so consistent proportions and connected anatomy are more important than variety.
Read left-to-right, row-major. Frames1–8 form a smooth monotonically lowering STAND→SIT transition. Feet remain planted; pelvis descends by joint bending only; crown continuously lowers, never bounces upward. Front-facing head, neck, collar, shoulders and chest-star all stay aligned; no independent sideways yaw. Arms and hands move continuously from side to knees. Same opaque shape scale, no shrinking silhouette to simulate sitting.

4 half squat; elbows bend and hands settle above knees.
5 deeper squat; same head size; pelvis lower.

Frames9–12 are a SEATED IDLE LOOP at EXACT SAME sitting height/head size/hair volume as frame8:
9 same seated pose, hands on knees, calm open eyes.
10 VIEWER-RIGHT hand rises only halfway to cheek, wrist at upper-chest level beside gold star, elbow bent.

Keep identity exactly: magenta iris VIEWER-LEFT, amber iris VIEWER-RIGHT, viewer-right star hair clip, cat ears, blue-purple long hair, white/navy-purple costume, chest star, short boots and attached tail. attempts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Correct a looping animation while preserving landing continuity.
INPUT1 is the EXISTING final falling pose of Gemini. INPUT2 is the EXISTING FIRST LANDING pose that follows. Both show the same character leaning/tilting strongly forward in the same direction with BOTH arms reaching down/forward, knees/boots behind, hair lifted upward.
Create FOUR new gently moving falling poses in a2x2 transparent sprite sheet, square2048x2048. These are a STEADY LOOP near INPUT1's exact forward-tilted orientation, not a transition sequence and not a spin. The character must NEVER return upright or sit in midair. Frame4→1 should be a tiny motion with no change of pitch/roll.
Use INPUT1 as the exact body/head orientation and identity. Keep neck, head, shoulder line, collar, chest, skirt and rear legs connected with exactly the same perspective. Preserve giant chibi head size, camera, body scale, long blue-purple hair, cat ears, viewer-right star clip, dress, boots and attached tail. Both palms reach down/forward for landing with two arms and10fingers total. Face eyes remain squeezed shut and mouth small startled oval, matching the landing anticipation. Do not introduce awake frontal smile or new expressions.
All four drawings occupy identical fixed cell center/scale/anchor; reserve generous transparent margins. Hair may softly sway but overall silhouette size must remain stable. Head cannot inflate and torso cannot shrink.
Frame1: nearly exact Input1 forward-tilted falling pose, hands open ready to land.
Frame2: exactly same torso/head pitch, wrists relax a couple degrees and left hair tips drift very slightly inward.
Frame3: same pose, right hair tips drift very slightly inward, fingers flex a tiny amount.
Frame4: same pose halfway back to frame1's wrist/hair positions, finishing with no angle discontinuity.
Keep the shoulder/head direction compatible with Input2's landing first frame so the loop can switch into landing at any time. No floor/contact plane is drawn; this is still airborne. True transparent alpha. NO text, numbers, grid lines, shadows, motion streaks, effects, external objects or extra limbs. Production game sprite quality matching the exact references, not redesigned character art.
attempts.reason: Four forward-tilted poses with small hand/hair motion remove the old upright reset and retain falling-to-landing direction.
